framework: NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
notes: Mapping pack only — does not assign US legal risk tiers. Outputs NIST Govern/Map/Measure/Manage subcategory mappings plus implementable technical controls.
CPPA ADMT and Colorado AI Act references appear as paper_ref context on employment/credit mappings, not as standalone law classifiers.

rules.summary: Maintain an inventory of AI systems with owners, purpose, and data categories.
recommended_controls: Register the system in the organizational AI inventory with a named owner
Record purpose, data types, deployment context, and autonomy level

technical_controls.summary: Register system metadata in the AI inventory at design time

rules.summary: Map employment-related AI that affects individuals — context, stakeholders, and intended/unintended impacts.
recommended_controls: Document stakeholders and foreseeable harms for employment decisions
Map data flows from application through model output to human decision

technical_controls.paper_ref: NIST AI RMF Map 1.1 / CPPA ADMT (significant decision — hiring)
technical_controls.summary: Document employment AI context and impact pathways before deployment

rules.judgment_call_note: CPPA ADMT significant-decision obligations apply when California consumers are affected; this mapping flags the pattern for review — it is not a CCPA compliance determination.

rules.summary: Measure fairness and performance for employment decision-support systems before production use.
recommended_controls: Define fairness metrics appropriate to the hiring workflow
Run pre-deployment evaluation on representative datasets

technical_controls.paper_ref: NIST AI RMF Measure 2.6 / EEOC technical assistance (employment AI)
technical_controls.summary: Run documented fairness/performance evaluation before production

rules.summary: Human review before adverse employment actions when AI supports or automates decisions.
recommended_controls: Require human review before rejecting or ranking down applicants
Log reviewer identity and override rationale

technical_controls.paper_ref: NIST AI RMF Manage 2.3 / CPPA ADMT (significant decision)
technical_controls.summary: Gate adverse employment outcomes on human review

rules.summary: Map creditworthiness AI — consumers affected, data sources, and decision pathways.
recommended_controls: Document credit decision logic and adverse-action notice workflow
Map third-party data sources and model inputs

technical_controls.paper_ref: NIST AI RMF Map 1.1 / Colorado AI Act (high-risk pattern — employment/credit)
technical_controls.summary: Document credit AI context and adverse-action pathway

rules.judgment_call_note: Colorado AI Act high-risk patterns may apply to credit decisions; seek counsel for scope — this is a mapping flag only.

rules.summary: Measure accuracy and robustness of credit scoring models.
recommended_controls: Validate model accuracy against holdout data
Monitor drift on credit outcomes in production

technical_controls.summary: Run validation and ongoing monitoring for credit models

rules.summary: Disclose AI use to customers in interactive systems.
recommended_controls: Disclose that the user is interacting with an AI system
Provide escalation path to a human agent

technical_controls.summary: Show AI disclosure in customer-facing UI

rules.summary: Define allowed actions and boundaries for agentic or autonomous AI systems.
recommended_controls: Document permitted tools, data scopes, and action envelopes
Require human approval for irreversible or high-impact actions

technical_controls.paper_ref: NIST AI RMF Govern 1.5 / Singapore MGF Agentic AI (action scope)
technical_controls.summary: Enforce allowed-action envelope for autonomous agents
Human override and kill-switch for autonomous actions

rules.summary: Test agentic systems for erroneous and unauthorized actions before deployment.
recommended_controls: Red-team agent workflows for out-of-scope actions
Log and alert on unauthorized tool or data access attempts

technical_controls.summary: Run agentic red-team scenarios in CI before release

rules.summary: Lightweight context mapping for internal, low-impact productivity AI.
recommended_controls: Document internal purpose and data handling
Re-classify if the tool processes personal data or faces external users

technical_controls.summary: Minimal internal system card with purpose and data scope

rules.summary: Re-evaluate AI system risk classification when purpose, data, or autonomy changes.
recommended_controls: Re-run classification on material system description changes
Pin ruleset version in CI for reproducible evidence

technical_controls.summary: Classify AI system metadata in CI when description files change
